title: garden pond hydrophone
author: odilonmarcenaro
changes: Real underwater (hydrophone) recording of a small weedy garden pond where newts, tadpoles and goldfish live, with soft ticks from raindrops and water insects, used for the axolotl (a salamander that makes no well-known call). Trimmed to 4.00–6.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass is applied because the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
